mapper.select: SELECT answer_status, inquiry_number, inquiry_title, inquiry_date, user_number FROM ( SELECT answer_status, inquiry_number, inquiry_title, inquiry_date, user_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inquiry_number DESC) AS rnum FROM ddd_inquiry WHERE user_number = #{userNumber} ) sub WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

SELECT inquiry_number, inquiry_title, inquiry_date, answer_status, inquiry_post, DATE_FORMAT(answer_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS answer_date, answer_post FROM ddd_inquiry WHERE inquiry_number = #{inquiryNumber} AND user_number = #{userNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ddd_inquiry ( user_number, inquiry_title, inquiry_post, inquiry_date, answer_status ) VALUES ( #{userNumber}, #{inquiryTitle}, #{inquiryPost}, NOW(), 'N' )
